name: TreemapExplorer
tagline: Treemap Explorer turns a list of records into a map of rectangles.
description: Treemap Explorer turns a list of records into a map of rectangles. Each rectangle (a tile) is sized by its share of the total, so the biggest categories stand out at once. Tap a tile to open it and see what it is made of, then open the records behind it.
features: Squarified tiles sized by amount or count
Two-level drill-down (group, subgroup, records) with breadcrumbs
Colour by group or by variance against a target, search
Top-N with Other bucket, KPI strip
Keyboard and touch navigation and a phone layout
